prompt: Give me five funny notes to tell my long time wife I love her very much
response:
Sure, here are five funny yet heartfelt notes you can leave for your long-time wife to let her know how much you love her:

1. "Dear Love of My Life, You're the only reason I can't resist the urge to dance in the kitchen. It's not the music, it's you! Love you more than yesterday, less than tomorrow. - Your Dancing Partner"

2. "To the woman who makes my life a comedy show, I love you. You're the only one who can make me laugh at my own jokes. - Your #1 Fan"

3. "Hey Honey, I love you so much that even when you forget to put the cap back on the toothpaste, I still find it hilarious. - Your Toothpaste Forgetter"

4. "Wife Extraordinaire, You're the only one who can make me forget why I was angry in the first place. Thanks for being my favorite distraction. - Your Accidental Apology Maker"

5. "To the woman who makes my life complete, I love you. Even when you insist on wearing those crazy socks, I still think you're the most stylish person I know. - Your Crazy Sock Admirer"

These notes blend humor with affection, reflecting the joy and laughter that often accompany a long and loving marriage.
